name: Pecoy Copper Corp.
summary: Pecoy Copper Corp., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration and development of mineral properties in Peru. The company explores for copper, gold, molybdenum, and silver deposits. Its flagship project is the 100% owned Pecoy Project which consists of 19 concessions covering an area of approximately 9,975 hectares located in southern Peru. The company is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
